propositions: Closing a bug ticket emits repeated 'Ambiguous prefix' diagnostics for bare 4-hex commit subject fragments that match multiple tickets because _resolves_to in blame.py calls resolve_ticket_id without quiet=True

derive_caused_by performs unbounded O(commits × tickets) work by re-resolving the bug_id on every commit in the branch history and scanning aliases for each candidate without memoization, causing a ~9 minute hang after the close commits durably

The fix passes quiet=True to all scanner call sites in blame.py, hoists bug_id resolution out of the per-commit loop, memoizes ref resolutions, and short-circuits hex-quad forms that cannot be prefixes of the target id

Documentation advertises bare 4-digit (single-quad) ticket references as a supported form despite collision risks; this must be removed from _ids.py module docstring and AGENTS.md while retaining compatibility resolution
